description.zh:
需要操作的规则ID列表，多个ID用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以调用[DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
List of rule IDs to be operated on, separated by English commas (,).
> You can call the [DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~) interface to get this parameter.

description.en: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) interface.
